# LLM Geopolitical Simulation

Autonomous **multi-LLM geopolitical simulation**: two models act as rival national leaders on a real-time calendar; a third model writes monthly journalist briefings shown on a web UI.

This repository contains two editions:

| Folder | Stack | Best for |
|--------|--------|----------|
| [`local version/`](local%20version/) | Ollama + FastAPI web UI + SQLite | Local / GPU or NPU machine |
| [`cloud version/`](cloud%20version/) | Gemini/Groq + LangChain + Chroma RAG + FastAPI + Docker | Near-$0 24/7 hosting |

## Features

- Calendar-driven turns (configurable real-time → sim week/month)
- Sliding short-term chat memory; cloud edition adds **RAG** (Chroma)
- Structured monthly briefings + archive web UI
- Resumable SQLite state and markdown chronicle logs
- Cloud: API provider failover, Docker Compose, rate-limit cooldowns

## Quick start

### Local (Ollama)

```bash
cd "local version"
python -m venv .venv
# Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
source .venv/bin/activate   # macOS/Linux
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env
# Start Ollama with the models listed in .env / README
python scripts/run_simulation.py
```

Open http://127.0.0.1:8080/

### Cloud (free APIs)

```bash
cd "cloud version"
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env
# Set GOOGLE_API_KEY and/or GROQ_API_KEY
python scripts/run_simulation.py
# or: docker compose up -d --build
```

Open http://localhost:8080/
